id1.description: Information pertaining to a subject of care that may need special consideration by a healthcare provider before making a decision about his/her actions in order to avert an unfavourable healthcare event, or relate to the safety of subject or providers, or pertain to special circumstances relevant to the delivery of care

id5.description: The date/time tat the issue or event commenced

id6.description: An indication of confidence concerning the existence of the alert

at7.description: The event or alert has been confirmed

at8.description: The issue or event is suspected to be present

at9.description: The issue or event has been discounted

id10.description: An indication of whether the alert is considered to be an active or inactive issue

id11.description: The date and time the alert requires review

at13.description: The alert is not active at present

id15.description: The end of the alert period if known

ac2.description: Coded categories of alerts based on a domain vocabulary

ac3.description: An indication of confidence concerning the existence of the alert (synthesised)

ac4.description: An indication of whether the alert is considered to be an active or inactive issue (synthesised)
